notes.title: March 9 Patch Update
notes.notes:
* Fixed the problem that the corresponding occupational attribute is abnormal (negative) when the weapon tower equipment has occupational bonus attribute entries
* Optimized the display position of the weapon tower, now it is sorted from right to left in order from 1 to 11 for easy viewing
* Optimized the interface for selecting the number of layers of the nest when clicking on the soldier

notes.title: March 8 patch fixes
notes.notes:
* Ranking of achievements
* Fixed the problem of overlapping display of 22 numbers
* Fixed the problem of the store button not being hidden when the transplant is not unlocked
* Fixed the problem of the same recipe materials for Rock Splitting Hammer and Flame Splitting Blade
* Fixed the problem of the same recipe materials for Star Crushing Bow and Cloud Crushing Crossbow
* Optimized the operation of recasting entries, and retained the data of the last recast entry selection

In addition, I wish everyone a happy March 8th~~

notes.title: Numerical adjustment/bug fix
notes.notes:
* Numerical display abbreviation
* Fixed the problem of calculation error of attack/life bonus entries and inconsistency in panel display
* Invisibility reduced to 6 seconds
*The number of Berserker targets increased to 2
*The number of targets in Thief's Mist has been reduced to 2
*The number of evil shaman targets increased to 2
* Meteoric Magister skill damage becomes 100%
* The self-destructing zombie skill changes to 7% of the target and 20% of the self
* The instructor skill drop rate decreases with the number of layers
* The SS career inheritance ratio calculation is changed to a single inheritance for each type instead of total value inheritance. The hp/atk calculation formula = sum of each type * ratio is no longer included in the number of captures.
* Weapon tower production time is 60 seconds
* xx professional attack/life bonus entry adjusted to 1-5%
* Shorten the build time and slightly increase the build cost
*Adjust the gain and change it to purchase with star coins
* If a duplicate formula is extracted from the turntable, a set of materials will be returned
*Monsters will activate damage reduction and life recovery as the level of difficulty increases.
